We observed PMMA and PS to exhibit similar zeta potential values before UV exposure (PMMA: -48.5 ± 1.5 mV; PS: -50.6 ± 2 mV). || This progression is also reflected in our zeta potential measurements of MP dispersions in 1 mM aqueous sodium chloride (NaCl) (Fig. 8B). || This progression is also reflected in our zeta potential measurements of MP dispersions in 1 mM aqueous sodium chloride (NaCl) (Fig. 8B).
